dct_title_s: Cloud Effective Radius, Suomi NPP / VIIRS
dct_description_sm: The VIIRS Cloud Effective Radius layer is a measure of cloud particle size in microns (μm). It is retrieved globally during day time for liquid and ice phases. Generally, smaller the particle size, brighter and more reflective are the clouds. The smaller cloud particles tend to reflect and scatter more sunlight back into space.

The VIIRS Cloud Effective Radius layer is available from the joint NASA/NOAA Suomi NPP satellite for daytime overpasses. The sensor/algorithm resolution is 750 m, imagery resolution is 1 km, and the temporal resolution is daily.

A daily visualization from NASA's Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS), available from 2012-03-01 and updated as new data arrive. Made from VIIRS/SNPP Cloud Properties 6-min L2 Swath 750 m (CLDPROP_L2_VIIRS_SNPP, version 1.1, doi:10.5067/VIIRS/CLDPROP_L2_VIIRS_SNPP.011).
